comment: Builder class for generating custom {@link Target} instances.

methods.name: public Builder setMinimumChroma(@FloatRange(from = 0, to = 100) float value)
methods.comment: Set the minimum chroma value for this target.

methods.name: public Builder setTargetChroma(@FloatRange(from = 0, to = 100) float value)
methods.comment: Set the target/ideal chroma value for this target.

methods.name: public Builder setMaximumChroma(@FloatRange(from = 0, to = 100) float value)
methods.comment: Set the maximum chroma value for this target.

methods.name: public Builder setTargetRelativeLuminance(@FloatRange(from = 0, to = 100) float value)
methods.comment: Set the minimum lightness value for this target, using Y in XYZ color space.

methods.name: public Builder setTargetPerceptualLuminance(@FloatRange(from = 0, to = 100) float value)
methods.comment: Set the minimum lightness value for this target, using L* in LAB color space.

methods.name: public Builder setTargetHue(@IntRange(from = 0, to = 360) int hue)
methods.comment:
* Set the hue desired from the target. This hue is not enforced, the only consequence
         * is points will be awarded to seed colors the closer they are to this hue.

methods.name: public Builder setContrastRatio(@FloatRange(from = 1, to = 21) float value, @FloatRange(from = 0, to = 100) float relativeLuminance)
methods.comment: Sets lightness value for this target.

methods.name: public Builder setChromaWeight(@FloatRange(from = 0) float weight)
methods.comment:
* Set the weight of importance that this target will place on chroma values. * *

The larger the weight, relative to the other weights, the more important that a color * being close to the target value has on selection. * *

A weight of 0 means that it has no weight, and thus has no bearing on the selection. * * @see #setTargetChroma(float)

methods.name: public Builder setLightnessWeight(@FloatRange(from = 0) float weight)
methods.comment:
* Set the weight of importance that this target will place on lightness values. * *

The larger the weight, relative to the other weights, the more important that a color * being close to the target value has on selection. * *

A weight of 0 means that it has no weight, and thus has no bearing on the selection. * * @see #setTargetRelativeLuminance(float)

methods.name: public Builder setPopulationWeight(@FloatRange(from = 0) float weight)
methods.comment:
* Set the weight of importance that this target will place on a color's population within * the * image. * *

The larger the weight, relative to the other weights, the more important that a * color's * population being close to the most populous has on selection. * *

A weight of 0 means that it has no weight, and thus has no bearing on the selection.

methods.name: public Target build()
methods.comment: Builds and returns the resulting {@link Target}.
